question: Does decomposing the current source-dominated Persona into explicit Acquisition Channel plus an outcome-free Behavioral Maturity profile improve future ranking and semantic quality?
hypothesis: Keeping source explicitly and clustering behavior/history separately will reduce semantic mixing and improve or preserve AP/lift versus the current persona_profile.
primary_change: replace persona_profile with acquisition_channel plus behavioral_profile
secondary_changes: behavioral clustering excludes source and all post-inquiry outcomes
same model family and all other profiles remain fixed

target.censoring: Public candidate data has no true sale timestamp. scheduled_visit is the observed proxy; offline results are associative.

population.eligibility: Same population and temporal partitions as E006_physical_location_spot: profile calibration before 2025-09-29T12:58:37, predictive training until 2026-04-28T07:41:43, final 20% future test.
exclusions: Profile-calibration inquiries are excluded from predictive fitting.

validation.strategy: outcome-free profile selection on frozen calibration data + same temporal predictive train and untouched future test; paired cluster-bootstrap by lead_id
validation.split_description: Clusterers use only information available before the frozen profile cutoff. Predictive models use the identical train/test rows across arms. Bootstrap resamples lead_id clusters.

items.evidence: Direct T0 lead field; separated from behavioral clustering to avoid source-dominated Persona labels.

items.source: leads.user_type, company_size, industry, prior_searches, prior_inquiries, has_converted_before
items.information_available_at: lead row before inquiry; clusterer fitted only on leads created before profile cutoff
items.evidence: No source, lead_score_internal, response outcome or future inquiry information is used.
